messages:
Zoe (AE): Heads-up — Meridian Health asked for a 2-week POC. Key asks in their security questionnaire: bulk SCIM import behavior, SAML encrypted assertions & specific ciphers, multi-domain TXT proof, IdP->RBAC mapping, session revoke semantics, and whether Dedicated is required for SSO spikes. Need SE/Sec/Infra quick check.
Kunal (SE): We can support SCIM v2 PATCH for deltas. For initial bulk import (they said ~28k users) recommend CSV bulk ingest -> background apply. We don't guarantee strict delta ordering; can add idempotency keys if they need ordering.
Ellen (Security): SAML: we support encrypting the whole assertion + NameID and attributes. We accept SP metadata with encryption cert. Algorithms requested?
Zoe (AE): They listed RSA-OAEP + AES-256-GCM in the questionnaire.
Ellen (Security): Those are supported. Also confirm they want encrypted attributes (email, roles) — that's fine. We'll need their SP metadata and cert chain.
Dmitri (Infra): Private/VPC POC takes ~10 business days. Hosted with region pin + CMK takes 48-72h. If they need CMK, provide KMS ARN and cross-account role.
Kunal (SE): RBAC mapping: pattern we use: SCIM groups -> Redwood roles; SAML transient claims -> session-scoped elevations. Example mapping snippet:
```
SCIM group: "meridian_ops" -> Redwood role: "org.operator"
SAML attr: roles=["auditor"] -> grant session scope: "audit.read"
```
Also ask for sample group names/claim keys.
Ellen (Security): Session revocation on deprovision supported via webhook + immediate blacklist. Hosted best-effort propagation ~<60s; Dedicated can offer tighter SLA. Note: SP-side cookies may persist until client clears or cookie expiry. Recommend short TTLs on SP.
Marisol (Legal): They requested SOC2 + DPA and want explicit contractual language that domain TXT proof is customer responsibility. We'll draft standard clause and share SOC2 report.
Zoe (AE): Pricing: they asked if Dedicated monthly commit could be small for POC (<$8k).
Dmitri (Infra): Dedicated mins typically higher. For POC, recommend hosted + short paid boost window. If they insist on Dedicated, need commercial exception and Sales Ops signoff.
Kunal (SE): Performance: SAML handshakes ~8 QPS average, CSV bulk import sustained ~100 QPS for import windows, SCIM deltas bursts up to 60 QPS. Hosted with boost handles this; Dedicated only if sustained >200 QPS.
Ellen (Security): Artifacts we need: SP metadata XML, sample CSV (first 500 rows), list of domains to verify, KMS ARN if using CMK, desired session TTLs, and any ordering requirements for SCIM deltas.
Zoe (AE): Can SE/Sec/Infra produce a 1-page FAQ for their infosec and infra teams? I'll include it with the questionnaire answers.
Kunal (SE): I'll draft the FAQ: SCIM bulk path + rate limits, SAML encryption options, RBAC mapping examples, session revoke behavior, and required artifacts. Will post by EOD.
Dmitri (Infra): I'll add the hosted vs private provisioning timeline and VPC checklist.
ops-bot: Scheduled: "poc-scim-boost" will run in staging in 3h for a 4h window. Reply \"cancel\" to abort.
Zoe (AE): Thanks team — I'll gather artifacts and loop back. If customer requests Dedicated early, we'll bring Sales Ops in. :thumbsup:
